attributes.content: Orders placed by 2 pm on a working day leave our warehouse the same day. Standard delivery takes 1–3 working days, express arrives the next working day.
Yes, from $50. Below that standard shipping costs $4.90 and express $9.90.

attributes.question: Can I return a phone I have already switched on?

attributes.content: Yes. You have 30 days to return any product – switched on and tried is fine, just send it back complete and without damage.

attributes.question: Do the phones come with a warranty?

attributes.content: Every phone has a 2-year warranty from the manufacturer and we handle the claim for you.
